_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json, then add sources from config/templates/. All values in shipped templates are placeholders. Set database.dsn explicitly for local SQLite (sqlite:///rumen.db) or Postgres (postgresql://HOST:5432/rumen, with the database user and password added in standard URL form); RUMEN_DB_DSN takes precedence when both are set. SQLite is never an implicit fallback.
